name: Forge
why: Kept. Draws on Fire: the forge is fire's heat put into iron. Red Iron, the edge-heat skill, is on it.

name: Rust
why: Kept. Draws on Fire's Smoulder: a slow burn, in iron. Metal's area utility.

name: Fuse
meaning: weld two into one piece: a foe chained to you, or two foes together
why: Re-meant to cover the duel: Fuse now also joins an enemy to you (Weld Line), not only two enemies together. Draws on both parents: Fire's heat welds, Earth holds it to your ground. Role, draw and effect kept.

name: Sunder
why: Kept. Draws on Earth's Crumble (break guard), and its spall on Earth's stone shrapnel.

name: Seal
why: Kept. Draws on Earth's Bury: one body held fast, here by its arms. The duellist's way to take a second foe out of the fight.

name: Breach
meaning: break a seal; punch through plate
why: Kept. Draws on Earth's Root and Bedrock Shove: point first through what stands in the way.

name: Hone
why: Kept. Draws on Fire's Sear: all of it into one thin line.

name: Dull
meaning: blunt edges, theirs included: take a blow on your blade and turn it dull
why: Re-meant to cover the parry: blunting an edge now includes taking the blow on your blade (Turn the Edge is a counter). Draws on Earth's Root: stand and take it. Role, draw and effect kept.

name: Plate
why: Kept. Draws on Earth's Harden: armour, worn instead of grown.

name: Strip
why: Kept: tearing armour off one enemy; the duellist's opener on a plated foe (and the choice: Stripped turns metal's own bonus off).
